get.description: Returns projects scoped to the caller: all for a platform admin, the projects consuming the caller's own provider's resources for a provider identity, or the caller's own project scope otherwise.

put.summary: Assign a resource to a project
put.description: Assigns a resource to a project (Admin or the owning provider identity). The resource is addressed by its per-provider natural key in the route (ADR-0026). Idempotent reactivation of a previously removed assignment. Returns 204; 400 on input validation; 403 when not allowed; 404 when the project or resource (or a cross-provider name) does not exist; 409 when the resource is already assigned or the project already holds a non-shared resource; 422 when the resource is read-only. Use the machine-readable `code`, not the message.

delete.summary: Remove a resource from a project
delete.description: Removes a resource's assignment from a project (Admin or the owning provider identity). The resource is addressed by its per-provider natural key in the route (ADR-0026). Returns 204; 400 on input validation; 403 when not allowed; 404 when the project or resource (or a cross-provider name) does not exist, or the resource is not assigned; 422 when the resource is read-only. Use the machine-readable `code`, not the message.

put.description: Updates a provider's description, support email, privacy, and country (Admin or the owning provider identity). Body {CountryCode, Description?, SupportEmail?, IsPrivate}. Returns 204; 400 on validation / unknown country; 403 when not allowed; 404 when the provider does not exist.

post.description: Reactivates a deactivated provider (Admin or the owning provider identity). Returns 204; 403 when not allowed; 404 when the provider does not exist; 409 when it is not deactivated.

post.summary: Add a location to a provider
post.description: Adds a location under a provider (Admin or the owning provider identity). Body {Name, Endpoint, LocationType, IsPrivate, IsShared, Description?}; LocationType is required and given by name (e.g. "HPC"). Returns 201 with a Location header; 400 on validation, including provider.invalid_location_type for an Unspecified, undefined or unseeded LocationType; 403 when not allowed; 404 when the provider does not exist; 409 when a location with the same name already exists.

put.description: Updates a location's endpoint and description (Admin or the owning provider identity). Body {Endpoint, Description?}. Returns 204; 400 on validation; 403 when not allowed; 404 when the provider or location does not exist; 409 when the location is deleted.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a location (Admin or the owning provider identity). Returns 204; 403 when not allowed; 404 when the provider or location does not exist; 409 when the location is already deleted.

post.summary: Assign a project resource to a location
post.description: Assigns a project resource to a location under a provider (Admin or the owning provider identity). The resource is addressed by its name (ADR-0024). Body {ResourceName, AllocationUnitType, AllocationUnitCount?, Description?, AggregationName?, Specifications?}. Returns 201 with a Location header to the created allocation (addressed by its slug); 400 on input validation (including an allocation unit type name that is not in GET AllocationUnitTypes) or a domain invariant breach; 422 on an allocation unit type with no catalog entry (None) or a read-only resource; 403 when not allowed; 404 when the provider, location, or resource does not exist. Use the machine-readable `code`, not the message.

put.description: Updates an assignment's details and replaces its specifications (Admin or the owning provider identity). Body {AllocationUnitType, AllocationUnitCount?, Description?, AggregationName?, Specifications?}. Returns 204; 400 on input validation (including an allocation unit type name that is not in GET AllocationUnitTypes); 422 on an allocation unit type with no catalog entry (None) or a read-only resource; 403 when not allowed; 404 when the provider, location, or assignment does not exist; 409 when the assignment is already deleted. Use the machine-readable `code`, not the message.

delete.description: Soft-deletes an assignment (Admin or the owning provider identity). Returns 204; 422 when the resource is read-only; 403 when not allowed; 404 when the provider, location, or assignment does not exist; 409 when the assignment is already deleted. Use the machine-readable `code`, not the message.

get.description: Returns active locations scoped to the caller: all for a platform admin, or the caller's own provider's locations for a provider identity.

Paged via ?page=&limit= (bare array; X-Total-Count and Link headers). includeInactive=true also lists deactivated providers, flagged IsDeleted: true, with their non-deleted locations. All providers for a platform admin, the caller's own provider for a provider identity.

Returns the provider's resources that the caller can see (assigned to a project the caller has a role on), optionally filtered by project short name, location type name (locationType, for example HPC; Unspecified matches nothing) and validity dates. Each assignment carries its LocationType as a name.

post.summary: Create a provider's resource and allocate it to one or more locations
post.description: Creates a resource under a provider and allocates it to every named location in one atomic transaction (ADR-0043/ADR-0050; Admin or the owning provider identity). The resource belongs to that provider and its name is unique per provider (ADR-0026). Body {Name, Description?, PrimaryInvestigatorEmail, StartDate, EndDate, Locations: [{LocationName, AllocationUnitTypeId, AllocationUnitCount?, AllocationDescription?, AggregationName?, Specifications?}]} — at least one location is required. All-or-nothing: any failing location aborts the whole request. Every named location's HEAppE instance is health-probed first; if any is unreachable, none of them are reported individually — the whole set of unreachable ones is returned together. Submits the create-and-allocate workflow asynchronously (ADR-0057) and returns 202 Accepted with a Location header to the request-status poll route and the flow RequestId in the body; 400 on input validation (incl. duplicate location+aggregation pairs) or a domain invariant breach (incl. requesting a second non-shared location for the same resource); 403 when not allowed; 404 when the provider or a named location does not exist; 409 when the name already exists for the provider; 422 on an unknown allocation unit type; 502 when one or more named locations' HEAppE instance is unreachable. Use the machine-readable `code`, not the message.

put.description: Updates a resource's metadata under a provider (Admin or the owning provider identity). The name and owning provider are immutable (rename is disabled, ADR-0030) — body {Description?, PrimaryInvestigatorEmail, StartDate, EndDate}. Returns 204; 400 on validation; 403 when not allowed; 404 when the resource does not exist under this provider. Use the machine-readable `code`, not the message.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a resource under a provider (Admin or the owning provider identity). Returns 204; 403 when not allowed; 404 when the resource does not exist under this provider. Use the machine-readable `code`, not the message.

post.description: Publishes a resource under a provider (Admin or the owning provider identity). Returns 204; 400 on validation; 403 when not allowed; 404 when the resource does not exist under this provider. Use the machine-readable `code`, not the message.

post.summary: Check account access to a clusters
post.description: Checks if the current user has access to a clusters.

post.summary: Provision accounts for a provider's resource
post.description: Provisions accounts for a resource under a provider (Admin or the owning provider identity). Returns 204; 400 on validation; 403 when not allowed; 404 when the resource does not exist under this provider. Use the machine-readable `code`, not the message.

Bearer.description: Paste only the JWT access token. The Bearer prefix is applied automatically.

Service.description: Paste only the service token in format: Service TOKEN/KEY
Service.name: Authorization
